tanks.cue: Watch the old tank, modern tank and IFV acquire a target 90 degrees to their right.

boats.cue: Compare progress after six seconds of throttle, four seconds of helm, then a stop order.

aircraft.cue: Coloured pulses identify the three actual gunship launch sockets; they do not represent firing cadence.

armaments.cue: Compare a fragmentation grenade, roughly 110 mm HE scale ground burst and a fuel explosion, followed by dirt, stone and metal impacts.

flares.cue: Watch the actual illumination flare descend under its parachute, drift, shed sparks and leave smoke behind.
